name: Exp_ForceTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the Force Trend indicator, which combines price force and trend direction to generate buy and sell signals. It opens positions when momentum confirms a trend shift and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy is a systematic momentum-following approach that aims to capture trending moves.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Force Trend指标进行交易，结合价格动力和趋势方向产生买卖信号。当动量确认趋势转向时开仓，并通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理交易。策略是一种系统化的动量跟踪方法，旨在捕捉趋势行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于Force Trend指标的动量跟踪系统。入场条件为Force Trend指标发出趋势方向确认信号时开仓做多或做空，通常依赖指标线的方向变化或穿越零轴来判断。出场条件包括触及止损或止盈水平，以及指标发出反向信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面，止损和止盈参数可配置但缺乏追踪止损或部分平仓等高级功能。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为基础，缺乏对市场波动性和流动性的适应性调整。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a momentum-following system based on the Force Trend indicator. Entry conditions trigger when the Force Trend indicator confirms a trend direction shift, typically using indicator line direction changes or zero-line crossovers as signals. Exit conditions include hitting stop loss or take profit levels, and closing positions when the indicator issues a reverse signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management relies on configurable stop loss and take profit parameters but lacks advanced features like trailing stops or partial position closing. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively basic, lacking adaptive adjustments for market volatility and liquidity conditions. The EA does not incorporate spread filtering or session awareness, which could lead to unfavorable entries during high-spread or low-liquidity periods.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调整参数
基于动量指标的趋势跟踪，在强趋势市场中表现较好
提供可配置的止损止盈，有基本的风险控制
代码结构简洁，便于二次开发和优化
使用魔术号区分订单，支持多EA并行运行
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and adjust parameters
Momentum-based trend following performs well in strong trending markets
Configurable stop loss and take profit provide basic risk control
Clean code structure facilitates further development and optimization
Magic number for order identification supports running multiple EAs simultaneously
cons: 固定手数不根据账户资金和波动性动态调整，资金管理不够灵活
缺乏追踪止损功能，趋势行情中可能无法锁定足够利润
无点差过滤和交易时段控制，可能在不利条件下入场
单一指标依赖，缺乏多维度信号确认，容易产生虚假信号
未实现新K线检查机制，可能导致同一根K线重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility limits money management flexibility
Lack of trailing stop functionality may fail to lock in sufficient profits during trending moves
No spread filter or trading session control may lead to entries under unfavorable conditions
Single indicator dependency without multi-dimensional signal confirmation prone to false signals
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated entries on the same candle
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态仓位管理和追踪止损功能
添加多时间框架确认和点差过滤机制以提高入场质量
实现新K线检查和交易时段控制，减少虚假信号和不利条件入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic position sizing and trailing stop functionality to improve profit capture and risk adaptation
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation and spread filtering to enhance entry quality and reduce false signals
Add new bar check and trading session controls to minimize false signals and unfavorable condition entries

risk_points: 固定手数无动态调整，大资金下风险敞口可能不匹配
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓增加风险
无点差过滤在高波动时段可能以不利价格入场
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment may lead to mismatched risk exposure under large accounts
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position openings on the same candle increasing risk
No spread filter may result in entries at unfavorable prices during high volatility periods

It opens positions when momentum confirms a trend shift and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy is a systematic momentum-following approach that aims to capture trending moves.
